commentary.text: 90+8' Mathieu Vernice is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' 2 - 2 Goal! Youssef El Arabi (Nantes) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top right corner. It's 2:2.
